name: enum-type/RED
query: MATCH (n:EnumConstant) WHERE n.name = 'RED' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: enum-type/missing
query: MATCH (n:EnumConstant) WHERE n.name = 'missing' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: local-type/x
query: MATCH (n:LocalVariable) WHERE n.name = 'x' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: local-type/missing
query: MATCH (n:LocalVariable) WHERE n.name = 'missing' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: field-type/field
query: MATCH (n:FieldNode) WHERE n.name = 'field' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: field-type/missing
query: MATCH (n:FieldNode) WHERE n.name = 'missing' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: annotation-head-error
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name = 'run' RETURN DISTINCT substring(n.caller_name,'bad') AS x LIMIT 1

name: invalid-needed-name-SID
query: MATCH (n:Field) WHERE n.name CONTAINS 'field' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: invalid-name-SID-after-true-class
query: MATCH (n:Field) WHERE n.class = 'Example' OR n.name CONTAINS 'field' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: all-type-name-merge
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.name CONTAINS '' RETURN DISTINCT n AS x LIMIT 10

name: all-type-name-merge-cross
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.name CONTAINS '' RETURN DISTINCT n AS x LIMIT 10
